findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_build_brief, get_doc_status, update_doc_settings, delete_doc, host_html_content, duplicate_doc, get_upload_url, get_doc_html, get_doc_url, patch_doc, check_rebuild, show_doc, app_read_doc, app_apply_edits · Private data: get_build_brief, update_doc_settings, delete_doc, host_html_content, get_upload_url, finalize_upload, get_doc_url, patch_doc, rebuild_doc · Public sink: list_docs, get_doc_status, update_doc_settings, delete_doc, invite_collaborator, suggest_link, host_html_content, get_upload_url, finalize_upload, get_doc_html, patch_doc, check_rebuild, show_doc · Destructive: delete_doc, invite_collaborator, get_doc_html, show_doc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_build_brief, get_doc_status, update_doc_settings, delete_doc, host_html_content, duplicate_doc, get_upload_url, get_doc_html, get_doc_url, patch_doc, check_rebuild, show_doc, app_read_doc, app_apply_edits · Private data: get_build_brief, update_doc_settings, delete_doc, host_html_content, get_upload_url, finalize_upload, get_doc_url, patch_doc, rebuild_doc · Public sink: list_docs, get_doc_status, update_doc_settings, delete_doc, invite_collaborator, suggest_link, host_html_content, get_upload_url, finalize_upload, get_doc_html, patch_doc, check_rebuild, show_doc · Destructive: delete_doc, invite_collaborator, get_doc_html, show_doc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
